## IRouteMediaBroadcastSend type

Media route atom: broadcast send fan-out.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IRouteMediaBroadcastSend<T extends IMediaKind> = INeverFields<`mode` | `options` | `editOptions` | `rich` | `richOptions` | `fallback` | `fallbackOptions` | `media` | `mediaOptions` | `resendOptions` | `chunkSize` | `type`> & {
    broadcast: IBroadcastSendParams;
    type?: never;
    keyboard?: IInBoKb | null;
    captionOptions?: IMediaReplyOpt<T> | null;
};
```
**References:** [INeverFields](./gramstax.ineverfields.md)<!-- -->, [IBroadcastSendParams](./gramstax.ibroadcastsendparams.md)<!-- -->, [IInBoKb](./gramstax.iinbokb.md)

## Remarks

The kind is read from the `<g-media>` block, not from `type`<!-- -->, because the same fan-out loop serves every kind — so `type` is unread here even on `renderMedia` where it is otherwise required.
